title: Kamishiro Rui — How Far I Have To Go〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: How Far I Have To Go（4★）

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My script is slowly starting to come together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I'm still uncertain...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Does this scene need to be more subdued, or more intense? The emotions I want to evoke would ordinarily demand intense expression, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's already morning...
I know it's a holiday, but I probably shouldn't have stayed up all night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I've let all these messages go unread...

rows.Speaker: Nene's Message
rows.Line: <How's the script coming along? Don't push yourself too hard and collapse on us, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Emu's Message
rows.Line: <Go, inspiration beam! Please help Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Message
rows.Line: <We're happy to talk if you ever feel like you need a break!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa's calling...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello? Do you need something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Don't give me that. Are you staying at home today?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's the plan. I need to keep working on this script.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Then, would you be okay with Emu, Nene and myself coming over later?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<We promise not to interrupt your work.
We just want to give you some things.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that seems fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Ah, excellent!
We'll let you know once we've arrived. See you then!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They want to give me some things? What could they be?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I am curious, but I need to stay focused.)
Two hours later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, your room's even messier than the last time we were here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I haven't had a chance to clean for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, if you're thinking about sitting on the sofa, then you'll need to watch your step. There's quite a lot on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is it even possible to reach it right now...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's just shove some of the things on the floor off to the side for now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel terrible about making guests do such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, is it just me, or do you have even bigger bags under your eyes now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Have you been getting enough sleep, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I've been taking naps when I can.
Unfortunately, today... Rather, yesterday I seem to have pulled an all-nighter.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I knew it.
And you haven't been eating properly either, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I don't think I've had anything since lunch yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Eating and sleeping take a back seat when I'm working. And when I'm focused, I don't particularly notice their lack.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose this is what it means to work tirelessly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We were right to come here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, this is for you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's full of nutritional snacks, drinks and other stuff that you should be able to have while you work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know the schedule for your homework is looking rough, but you still need to eat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, thank you. I'll be careful.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, we brought plenty of other snacks too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So many bags... Are these all soda candies?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I bought lots of different kinds for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They should help cheer you up whenever you're super busy or if anything bad happens!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, these should come in handy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean you're allowed to live off just those.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That just leaves me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's clear that you haven't been getting enough sleep lately, so I decided to bring you some helpful goods.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
For example, regarding your naps...
This eye mask should help turn them into power naps.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it's one of those that you can warm or cool as you please.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Please give it a try when your eyes are feeling tired after a long day of scriptwriting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I brought some music that should help whisk you away into the world of dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, what do we have here...? CDs?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're the piano medleys I listen to from time to time. Most of the songs have a night theme to them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope they help you rest your mind and body, to better focus on your work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll give them a listen later.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, you all came over here today just to give me these?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is the least we could do for a friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We may not be able to help you with your assignment, but we can provide you with support in other ways.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can do it, Rui! We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I couldn't have asked for better friends...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show is going to be a little different from my usual ones, but it should be a good one.
